About.paragraph: PT Nextin Tech Innovation is an information technology consulting company based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Established in 2021, we were founded out of a concern for the rapid advancement of technology and the growing need for businesses to adapt in the digital era. Since our inception, we have been committed to becoming a strategic partner for various organizations in implementing digital solutions that are innovative, efficient, and sustainable. With a team experienced in software development, system integration, and digital transformation, PT Nextin Tech Innovation has successfully completed numerous projects and continues to manage ongoing initiatives today. The trust of our clients from Indonesia, Australia, and UK stands as a testament to our commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality, and results-oriented services. We believe that every digital transformation begins with a deep understanding of business needs, followed by the implementation of the right technology. Through collaboration, innovation, and dedication, we continuously strive to help our clients reach their full potential in this digital era.

Gallery.title: Trading Web & Mobile Application
Gallery.desc: We have developed a mobile and web application for our clients in the trading industry from indonesia and UK. The project has been completed and published. Currently, we are continuing development by adding new features as well as performing continuous maintenance and support.

Gallery.title: Financial web & mobile application
Gallery.desc: We have also developed a website and mobile application for one of our clients from Australia who operates in the financial services, financial consulting, and investment management sectors. The project has been successfully completed and published. Currently, we are continuing our collaboration by developing new features and providing ongoing system maintenance and support.

Gallery.title: Dealer & leasing Web application
Gallery.desc: We developed an internal website for one of our clients in the dealer and leasing services industry. The project includes several modules that support internal business processes, such as BPKB management, insurance, fund disbursement, daily closing, data updates, and more.The system has been successfully launched and is currently under continuous development with new features and modules to further enhance the client's operational efficiency.

Services.name: Android Development
Services.text: We have designed, developed, and currently manage several Android applications that are widely used in both the financial and consumer goods sectors in Indonesia. This experience enables us to build custom Android apps that drive engagement and growth for your business.

Services.name: IOS Development
Services.text: We have designed, developed, and currently manage several iOS applications that are widely used in both the financial and consumer goods sectors in Indonesia. This experience allows us to create tailor-made iOS apps that enhance customer engagement and accelerate your business success.

Services.name: Web Development
Services.text: We create intelligent websites designed to capture attention, engage visitors, and drive conversions. Using our custom website CMS, we deliver platforms tailored to your needs, complete with e-commerce functionality and unique integrations specific to your business.

Services.name: Maintenance & development
Services.text: In addition to developing new solutions, we also offer maintenance services for projects we have created as well as existing client projects, ensuring long-term performance and reliability.

Team.name: Eki Hie
Team.desc: Eki is a creative dreamer who is always looking for new ways to improve in everything he does. After failing to grow his own startup, he became obsessed with learning from past mistakes and decided to gain experience elsewhere to keep evolving. Keeping up with the times, Eki studied many areas, including business and technology, which gave him a solid foundation to become a strong leader. This led to Nextin, a business team operating in the IT sector that now works with several brands in Indonesia and abroad.

Team.name: Fadilla Imran
Team.desc: As the Chief Operating Officer, Fadilla Imran is recognized as a visionary leader with exceptional problem-solving skills and a calm, strategic approach to overcoming challenges. With a strong background in operations and management, Fadilla drives efficiency, innovation, and sustainable growth across all aspects of the organization. With analytical sharpness, an adventurous mindset, and adaptive character, Fadilla Imran continues to be a driving force behind the company’s ongoing success and meaningful evolution.
